# A withdrawn label, and why we kept it

The withdrawn sentence is still on the [Wi-Fi page](f-wifi.md), struck out and followed by its reason: *"Gate 0x27 read
0xF, so the coprocessor's clock was already on."* The [Bestiary](../bestiary.md) keeps it as a ruled-out lead on the
Whisperer's clock front. Anyone who finds the old map could reopen a closed lead, which is why the correction stays
visible, next to what it corrected.

The Whisperer still keeps its secret: which physical gate feeds the coprocessor is not known. Someone after you may
find it, or may show that the question was framed wrongly.

If you notice two sheets that disagree, or a page that says more than its proof, [suggest a correction](https://github.com/SebE585/trognon/issues/new?template=correction.yml). A correction is as welcome as a
discovery. Five ways to take part: scout (spots an inconsistency), archivist (checks a source), decipherer (reads a
clue), witness (repeats an observation), cartographer (corrects a map). Which trace would you leave?
